messages.subject: Re: Problem with the yellow toques
messages.text:
I wasn't going to say anything but I was very disappointed in the color. I really was hoping for a vibrant yellow, like the color of goldenrod it's my jam, but since you are a small business and not Amazon I decided to keep my mouth shut. I chalked it up to, that's what you get when you order online. So since you asked, yes I really was hoping for a vibrant yellow beanie. 
 Thanks,
 Aubrey 

 On Tue, Jan 27, 2026, 12:48 PM Lasclay <hey@lasclay.com> wrote:

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Hi Aubrey,

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We want to let you know about an issue with our new batch of yellow beanies that we recently received from a new supplier.

 It is really not the same yellow at all, and we are quite disappointed.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 It’s not ugly, but it is not the same warm, vibrant yellow we were used to, and the one shown on our website at the time of purchase.

 We decided to ship them anyway, since many people had been waiting a long time for their order and this was the only missing item. However, we will absolutely listen to your feedback and any requests regarding this. 

 We look forward to hearing from you once you receive your order.

 Warmly, and we’re sorry for this.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Gabriel 
Co-founder

messages.text:
Hello Aubrey,
 

 We are truly sorry for the situation regarding your order. We fully understand how disappointing it can be to receive a product that does not match what was expected, and we would like to offer you our sincerest apologies.
 

 To spare you any further procedures, such as a return or waiting for a refund, we would like to propose a simple and quick solution:
 ✨ free shipment of a new beanie , in gray or black color , at no cost to you.
 

 This beanie is offered to you and you may, of course, keep it.
 

 We sincerely hope that this solution will suit you.
 

 Just let us know your preferred color, and we will take care of the rest.
 

 Looking forward to assisting you.
 

 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay

messages.subject: Re: Problem with the yellow toques
messages.text:
Wow! That is very generous and tempting. However as I think about it, I just don't need another hat. I am trying to embrace 'less is more,' so if I already have one of something, I don't need to get another one. So as long as you are fine with me wearing your yellow hat out and about in the world, then I am too. No need to send along a replacement. The color has grown on me and hasn't stopped me from wearing it. 

 I see what you are doing and appreciate your effort to improve the customer experience. Thank you. 

 Keep doing your good work and innovating new ways to use milkweed fibers. Managing a small business isn't easy. Props to the company! 

 

 Aubrey
